title: I-Controller Design Using Root-Locus for Belt-Driven Rotational System
expert_review: Excellent problem combining physical modeling, transfer function derivation, and classical control design using root locus. Challenges students to connect theory with practical objectives like pole placement and disturbance rejection.
learning_objectives: Derive transfer functions from mechanical rotational systems
Apply root-locus method to design integral controllers
Determine optimal controller gain for critical damping
Assess asymptotic tracking and disturbance rejection capabilities
Interpret breakaway points in root-locus plots
